title: Minimum Rotations to Dial a Number II
summary: A circular zero-through-nine dial starts at zero. Before dialing the digit string, you may reverse one suffix, or leave it unchanged. Moving to an adjacent dial digit costs one in either direction. Return the minimum total rotation steps after choosing the suffix optimally.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 decimal digits; supplied n equals string length.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
